prompt.text: Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of MANTA. Redraw the referenced subject as the sheet described below. Keep the exact design, silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials, top-left lighting, outline weight and rendering style of the reference in every cell; only the pose or state changes from cell to cell, and the layout follows the grid described: Retro 16-bit video game sprite sheet for a horizontal shooter, a regular grid of ten equal cells in two rows of five with even gutters, every cell showing the same flat pale-mint manta-ray-shaped starfighter with a small green canopy, amber twin thrusters and a heavy near-black green outline in side view facing right, on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. Top row, the five banking frames from left to right: steep climb with the nose and the leading wing edge tilted up, slight climb, level glide, slight dive, steep dive with the nose tilted down. Bottom row, the level-glide hull with five thruster states from left to right: idle with two short amber embers, small twin flames, medium twin flames, long red-amber twin plumes, and full boost with white-hot cores in both plumes. Every sprite drawn as crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black green outline at its native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading lit from the top-left, identical scale, position and silhouette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no drop shadows, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders, arcade sprite art. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. Every player craft faces right: nose pointing to the right, engines and exhaust on the left. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
prompt.negative: overlapping sprites, drop shadows, background gradient, real manta ray, animal texture, visible fish eye, perspective distortion, anti-aliasing, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, green tint on the hull, blurry, photorealistic, 3d render, watermark
